text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a stroll through town on my day
off when I spot Satono
Diamond. She looks
somewhat troubled.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! You came at just the right
time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go to an amusement
park?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's so busy when you haven't
booked the whole place out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks for coming on such short
notice. I had a VIP pass set to
expire
today, so it would've gone to waste. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita had something urgent come up, so I
was thinking I'd have to
come alone!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I could hardly sleep a wink last
night, and—Oh! Look, it's
Uma-kun! We
have to get a photo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry! Come join the picture! Okay,
say "cheese!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's... oh,
over there! That line's so
long! Come on, let's go join
it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm always being let in right away,
so I
want to try savoring the
anticipation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We spend an hour or so chatting in line.
When our turn finally comes,
we enter the
attraction.

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Groooaaar!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe! What a fright! This is so fun! ♪
Where did it even come
from?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that a hidden door? That's it!
I bet
the zombie was waiting
behind there. Let's
go see!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This haunted house is so cutting-edge! I
have to get a look behind
the scenes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hnnng! That was so fun! Every attraction
was a blast!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we're not done yet! Next up is the
park's game plaza! Come on,
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They have a number of claw machines here
from my family's
conglomerate.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look! That one has the park's
merchandise! They're all so cute!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, given their position,
we should wait
until they reset them. Let's
warm up on the
other machines first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, claw machines are my specialty! I've
been playing them since I
was little!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I often accompanied my parents when they
made visits to our affiliate
game company.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The claw machines were a fun way of
passing the time while I waited
for them to
finish work.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, more like I tagged along because I
wanted to play on the
machines! Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just sit back and watch!
♪ I'll win you
whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In no time at all, Satono Diamond wins me
a whole armful of prizes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ See? Told you it was my
specialty! And I'm just getting
started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pack the prizes into a large shopping
bag, but with so many, we'll
probably have
to carry some home in our arms...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I might've gone a little overboard.
Shall we call a taxi later to
take us back?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to get so carried away
again... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, this happened with
the Floral Makeover Project
too. Trainer is
always going along with what I want.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Is this what my upperclassman at the
meeting meant? Am I taking
advantage of
Trainer's kindness?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, don't worry about getting those
home—I'll manage somehow!
I do have
Umamusume strength, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing.
I'm sorry for getting carried
away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she's smiling, she looks bothered
by something. Maybe
brightening up the
mood would help her open up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll aim for... the prize she called cute
earlier!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's the park's merch...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow! You got it! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...!
Wow, are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But I only did that because I wanted to...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I know!
I'll get the same one so that we're
match—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: U-um... never mind!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll take good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's smile looks a little
unsure. I've seen many new sides
to her
today, but I'm not sure what to make of
this one.
